[EN] [Event] Would You Like to Play a Game
[ES] [Evento] ¿Te gustaría jugar a un juego?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go meet Langon, who you see in front of the tavern over there.
[ES] Ve a encontrarte con Langon, a quien ves frente a la taberna de allí.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Now, enjoy the festival as much as you want.
[ES] Ahora, disfruta del festival tanto como quieras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sure, I can do that."
[ES] "Claro, puedo hacerlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go meet the little popori 'Langon' in front of the West Beach Tavern.
[ES] Ve a encontrarte con el pequeño popori 'Langon' frente a la taberna de West Beach.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect sand from sand piles near the water and make 3 sand castles.
[ES] Recolecta arena de los montones de arena cerca del agua y haz 3 castillos de arena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Used construction sand to build a sand castle. (1/3)
[ES] Usaste arena de construcción para construir un castillo de arena. (1/3)
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use construction sand to build sand castles.
[ES] Usa arena de construcción para construir castillos de arena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Used construction sand to build a sand castle. (2/3)
[ES] Usaste arena de construcción para construir un castillo de arena. (2/3)
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use construction sand to build sand castles.
[ES] Usa arena de construcción para construir castillos de arena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Used construction sand to build a sand castle. (3/3)
[ES] Usaste arena de construcción para construir un castillo de arena. (3/3)
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "That actually does look like fun."
[ES] "La verdad es que sí parece divertido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go meet the little popori 'Langon' in front of the West Beach Tavern.
[ES] Ve a encontrarte con el pequeño popori 'Langon' frente a la taberna de West Beach.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sure, I'll try that."
[ES] "Claro, lo intentaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Wahmel, the manager of the melon bash game area.
[ES] Encuentra a Wahmel, el encargado de la zona del juego de romper melones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Wahmel to participate in the melon bash game.
[ES] Habla con Wahmel para participar en el juego de romper melones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sounds pretty easy."
[ES] "Suena bastante fácil."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Wahmel, the manager of the melon bash game area.
[ES] Ve con Wahmel, el encargado de la zona del juego de romper melones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "This could be fun. I'm in."
[ES] "Esto podría ser divertido. Cuenta conmigo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Chelton, the manager of the splash cannon game area.
[ES] Ve con Chelton, el encargado de la zona del juego de cañones de agua.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Chelton to participate in the splash cannon shooting game.
[ES] Habla con Chelton para participar en el juego de disparos con cañón de agua.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay, I'll play!"
[ES] "¡De acuerdo, jugaré!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Chelton, the manager of the splash cannon game area.
[ES] Habla con Chelton, el encargado de la zona del juego de cañones de agua.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay, I'm in!"
[ES] "¡De acuerdo, entro!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go see Stefanna on the other side of the beach.
[ES] Ve a ver a Stefanna al otro lado de la playa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm on my way."
[ES] "Ya voy en camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go meet Dolme the horn carver in a hut on the east coast.
[ES] Ve a encontrarte con Dolme, el tallador de cuernos, en una choza en la costa este.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Warthog Molar
[ES] Molar de jabalí
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Get a molar of a baykun warthog on Serpentis Isle.
[ES] Consigue un molar de un jabalí baykun en Serpentis Isle.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the molar you got to Dolme.
[ES] Entrégale el molar que conseguiste a Dolme.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sounds good."
[ES] "Me parece bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Popori Statue
[ES] Estatua de popori
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the popori statue to Ramsay, the owner of the East Beach Tavern.
[ES] Llévale la estatua de popori a Ramsay, el dueño de la taberna de East Beach.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks. It's been a blast so far."
[ES] "Gracias. Lo he pasado genial hasta ahora."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
